create_union_autocomplete: create a union of multiple shell autocomplete functions that merges their completion results
create_intersection_autocomplete: create an intersection of multiple shell autocomplete functions that returns only common completion results
create_conditional_autocomplete: create a conditional autocomplete function that chooses between two completers based on a predicate
get_defined_processes: get a list of all defined process names from the MRP process definitions registry
get_running_processes: get a list of currently running process names from the MRP system state
